title: Great
content: This app is perfect. All my friends and family can follow the journey day by day like a journal
author: Jakey413

title: I love Polar Steps
content: It helps me keep track of my travels and trips to different countries and places.
author: azacharia

title: Great App
content: Great way to follow friends or track where you�ve travelled yourself.
author: Wildflower1970

title: iPad or something
content:
Trying to sort through photos and access the maps on a iPhone screen is not ideal. Why not an iPad version to make it easier???

Keeps being the top 1 or 2 battery usage app on my iPhone 16. Not impressed.
author: Dateman

title: Excellent app
content: Easy to navigate, and easy to spread the news
author: Peegee60

title: Love it
content: Great for following others journey and sharing your own
author: oomowmamowmow

title: First time user
content:
We installed Polarsteps to try on our latest trip and were very surprised how easy and great it is to use 
It’s a bit hard when you are in a non service area like middle of the Simpson desert to have it track your movements but you can manually set locations and then add pictures, it may not show exact travel but adds a straight line 
Whilst in service it really tracks well 
   We ordered the photo book at the end and were really pleased not knowing what we were really getting but it’s awesome. It is an easy process to add or remove photos for the book and we are now adding a trip we done last year to Polar Steps so as we can have a book done 
Cheers Polarsteps keep tweeting the app to make it better 
Loyal user
author: Andy & Ali

title: Great travel companion
content: I’ve been using polarsteps for a few years now and it’s a great way to capture little stories and photos of your trips. The tracking works pretty seemlessly in the background and adding photos from your phone is straightforward. It’s a great way to help friends with planning trips as you can just share a link and give them a look at your itinerary to see if it appeals.
author: Hel0008

title: Best travel app
content: I have been using Polarsteps for 5 years and love it. I can record trip diaries and photos so easily. And the travel books are such good quality and delivered so quickly after ordering. I recommend Polarsteps to all my friends who are travelling. It’s also handy to check travel tips from other friends who use the app. It’s user friendly and produces a professional product.
author: Love Polarsteps

title: Great App
content:
We loved our Polarsteps on a trip last year. Such an intuitive interface and makes it super easy to organize travel memories. Then the book we made is gorgeous, it lives on our coffee table and we love looking back at our trip. 
So easy and such a great result - I’m the type who would never get around to doing it if I didn’t have some help and Polarsteps is the help I needed.
author: NR Folk

title: Polarsteps review
content: I’m finding the Polarsteps easy to use once you get used to each step. You can add in any step or delete it as you wish. Alterations can be made if you don’t like the photos or script. I love that you can see where you’ve travelled on the world map and all the stops along the way, and it’s instant for your followers. Yes I would recommend Polarsteps for your travel blog. Happy travelling.
author: Her Wheels

title: Great for keeping in touch
content: I love this because it files your photos in the place where we visited. Instead of trying to find photos amongst the thousands on my phone, I just go to the map on Polar steps. We’ve told fellow travellers about Polar steps too, so that we can catch up if we notice they’re close by on our travels. And our family and friends can follow our travels too.
author: Tricksie3

title: Straight lines
content: Absolutely love this app and have used it on our last couple trips we have done. Love how it tracks where you have been stops you have made and you can keep track of where your photos were taken. One thing I wish was changed was instead of having straight lines for where you have been, if they were changed and actually followed exactly where you went.
author: Tamika41

title: Must have long road trip app
content: Awesome app that tracks your steps pretty much as accurate as possible. Love that you can add photos to each step and that it works offline. Doesn’t drain the battery and I can’t wait to get a book made at the end. There is very little that would even make it better, but when I think about it, nothing comes to mind! My favourite app ever. Well done guys and girls who came up with this!
author: Blackycs3011

title: A good travel tracking app.
content: Was referred to this by some who have been travelling and have this quite useful. It can be a bit clunky getting information into the app however it does provide the opportunity to capture as much information as you can about your trip. I am sure that with some enhancements, this could be a very handy app, however using Location Services, this can lead to heavy battery usage.
author: Grumpy2736543

title: The best way to travel
content: Love this app. The best way to record a trip and to follow others without having to use the major social media platforms. So easy to post a few pictures each day and a brief description, and over time you build up a great record of your trip. Haven’t used the planning features yet, but the books are excellent.
author: david_3226

title: Family Top End Holiday in Australia
content: This app has been wonderful in travelling with our WA family virtually on their long service leave holiday. We can follow them, see photos of where they have been and communicate while on their road trip. We will use this app when we do our own  big trip. Thanks for allowing us to keep in touch this special way.
author: LRD4444

title: Great travel blog
content: I have used Polarsteps for our last 3 trips and it is great! The app tracks your trip on a map which is really cool. You can easily add photos and text. I like the option to draft and save a step and to be able to add and delete from this before publishing it. Friends can be invited to follow along and comment once they have the app. A great travel tool!
author: JenSheertravels

title: Amazing for Travel
content: I absolutely love this app, we travelled around Australia & updated our steps at each spot we stayed at, once we were home we reviewed & ordered the photo book. It’s incredible. Such a great way to easily create a long lasting memory. I never would have been bothered to do it if the app. didnt keep track along the way! Incredible! Highly recommend!
author: Brooklyn1411

title: Great travelling app
content: Love this app! Can track your phone as you go and pinpoint every time you stop so you can add photos later or at the time. Very accurate in location. Can have as private or public profile, great for my family to be following my travels. And it's free! I wish I could purchase the travel book but not available in Australia. Highly recommend.
author: TanyaTravellingAustralia

title: Thfjekdjgj
content: I think this is a great app to like show people what you have done in the holidays and at the end you can pay for it to make a book of your adventure but you have to add what you are doing while you are doing it so it can see where you are so if you forget then idk how to add something that you did so please tell me how to do that because I am quite confused. Overall pretty great would recommend.
author: Ibfjriricisjshchfir

title: Great App But Don’t Change Your email
content:
I’ve used this app for 7 years.. Created 10 books of my travels.. Then I had to change my email. Bad luck.. you can start a new account but you loose all the books you’ve made.. simply because you have a new email.
Support was not really forth coming..
So now it’s move on to another photo book company..
Great app to have.. but don’t change your address or email..
author: Sandragames

title: Great App
content: We are using Polarsteps for our 12 month trip around Australia and it has been awesome.  Not only is it easy to use but it keeps our family and friends updated on where we are and what we are enjoying.  It is also a great record for us to refer back to during our travels and of course a great record to keep once we return.
author: The Big Trip

title: Love Polarsteps
content:
Love the  Polarsteps App!  Have used it for a few trips and printed books at the end of them. Which have been fantastic!  Have recommended Polarsteps to lots of friends and family and they love it too! Love the whole set up with the map with photos, adding the description, inviting people to follow, even has the temperature of the day 😅👍so easy to use, it’s a great trip diary! 
It’s fantastic! 😊
author: Sandra Calavassy

title: My European adventure
content:
Hi everyone 
Just letting you know how fabulous Polarsteps is. Uploading photos and describing my daily activities for my friends to follow is fantastic. It’s like my own personal journal so I can always remember where I have been. I have been in Belgium, London and am now on a cruise to Iceland. The app is tracking where I have been and my friends can see it too. I love it
author: Barnsie’s travels

title: Great trip review app
content:
We started using Polar Steps just after we started our adventure, it’s great to keep family and friends up to date with our travels and gives our overseas family an idea of the size of our great country.
Would have loved to be able to add the first section of our travels to our current trip other wise great app
author: MrMcgoo2

title: Best travel tracking app
content:
Polarsteps is by far the best travel tracking app I have ever used, I just don’t start my travels anymore without this app, it’s just fun to revisit every step as a memory after the trip is done.

Once feedback is to add few more options like category where users can define restaurant, activity, sports etc and mode of transport option.
author: ankit.upadhyay

title: 2nd trip using Polarsteps
content:
I recommend Polarsteps unreservedly. It’s easy to use, easy to access and has a great look. Friends can interact with the photos and stories you post.  And for me one of the not so obvious elements of Polarsteps is that it is a tool to help you reflect and make sense of the some of things you have seen and heard and observed during the day. A great tool for reflection. 
Ross
author: RoscoKM

title: Easy way to inform selected people of trip & our whereabouts
content:
Loving Polarsteps and that I can select who sees our adventures. It such an easy way to track where we’ve been and able to pop in photos to remind us of each place. 
It will be an easy way to create an album at a later stage if we wish. Loving this app. 5 stars,  thanks Polarsteps
author: JL3357

title: Fantastic app
content:
Started on this app back in 2022 due to a fellow traveller showing it to me. It has been a digital diary of my trips so far, shows so much information like % of the world travelled, flags and so much more and then you can end up printing a Hard or soft cover book with all your favourite pictures from your trip and have it handy on a coffee table.
ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC
author: Smokingsammy

title: Sharing a trip
content: Excellent way to let others know where you are and what is going on. Being able to write about the day or place keeps the many events recorded. Keeps the photos linked to the place. Will be editing it on return. Saves contacting individuals one by one as they can see what’s going on. Easy to post.
author: jg74583

title: Tracking my intrepid brother
content: Great little app for tracking friends and family on their intrepid trips, it makes it really easy and travel specific. The map is a fantastic visualisation feature and to have the photos as a slide, with the diary and commentary confidently underneath, brilliant! Didn’t have these things when I was travelling like that 😅
author: Incognittoo

title: Best travel memories
content: Have used this travel app many times and so have a few of my friends. I love how it tracks your movements in real time and gives you the weather of the day. I can share my location and commentary-and photos . The best part is the beautiful book you can order. It is of exceptional quality .
author: Little Purds

title: What a great App!
content: This is my first ever app review, but Polarsteps is just so fantastic I just have to tell everyone! The ease of use when planning our caravan trip was fantastic, now we can see how many KM and hours it is between stops, I’m sure that I have all the nights away accounted for and I can share it with our friends and family!
author: Amamba12

title: Great travel app
content:
Great to record my memories as I travel. Can also use to print travel book when you return - expensive if you are in Australia but still a good option as easy to use. 
Also good to follow other people’s travels and record options for where to go when I go to those places.
author: TannyWanny

title: Cant exit trip
content:
Intent is good and it almost does it. 
But, when I open a trip to look back over it, I can’t exit the trip without completely shutting down the app and restarting.
Ok. Apparently there’s a tiny-wee faint arrow at the top left of the page that takes you back. So, now that I know it’s there, problem is solved and another star is now earned = that makes three. Would be nice if that arrow was more visible. 
Get that, and if this works as advertised on my next trip, another star is likely.
author: Notaffluentenoughyet

title: Europe 2024
content: I cannot believe how fabulous our 144 page book has turned out. 8 days after arriving home I’m reliving our magical trip. The clarity of the photos, the format, the quality, the detail. Best souvenir of an amazing trip. I’m heading back into my photos of past trips to create more books. Highly recommend, so easy, so brilliant 👏🏼👏🏼
author: Max JJ10

title: Small issue but frustrating
content:
This app really requires the ability to save progress even though there are too many pages when editing a travel book. On a large trip it can take many hours to get the pages down to the point it is saveable.

In my case it opens at 700 odd pages and needs to get down under 400 to save it.
author: Wingoo69

title: Back loging
content:
I love the concept of this app. But two things id change are that I’d like to be able to back date my trip from when it started to now so I can get the whole lot of kms and places in. As I didn’t know about the app before my trip started. Also it would nice to tag things like farmers markets and museums I went to or cafes etc for remembering the experiences.
Very awesome you can edit stuff though and cool world map/route tracking.
author: Jaceyface

title: Fantastic App
content: I think this app is fantastic, it is by invitation only to follow those you know, as they need to accept you as a follower. As long as they post their whereabouts with pictures and comments you can see exactly where they are and what the area is like, a highly recommended app for travelers and their family and friends.
author: Nan2253

title: Memory keeper and stunning coffee table gems
content: Polarsteps has changed the way I record, share and recall out trips. From the interactive online share ability to share details with family and friends - all for free, to the magnificent bound picture books that are worth every cent. Highly recommend trip ‘companion’.
author: Camiluod

title: Mumma check in
content: My son is traveling in some fairly isolated places in central South America and being able to check where he is each day has been incredibly reassuring. Absolutely love following his travels, looking up the places he is in as well as enjoying his blogs and photos. Thanks Polar steps don’t know what I’d do without you 😊
author: Lamingtonhiker

title: Travel diary
content:
It’s really a nice app and they made some very good progress since the beginning I’ve been using it! 
That would be even better to be able to choose several mode of travel for one trip (ie. car from one place to another and then train from that place to another) please !
author: TamDmz

title: Easy to use travel app for sharing photos and locations
content: I use Polarsteps each time I travel as it is easy for my followers to keep track of where I am - uploading photos is quick & at the end of my trip I have all my travel info & photos in one place with locations and dates
author: Jasperini

title: What a great way to remember your holiday
content: We have been in the, Eastern Europe, Balkans and Turkey for three months. Can’t remember where we have been so Polarsteps is great to retrace your steps. A few of my Grey Nomad friends are also travelling n other continents so it’s good to see what they are up to. We comment on each others posts so it keeps the reporting interesting.
author: JamesShelagh

title: Beautiful book of special memories
content: The book of our trip is wonderful. Great quality and a special memory. It was a first travel book and putting  the book together with the words was a fair amount of work. But there was great support to be had with any difficulties we came across.  A great experience
author: Adrobanadro

title: Great trip tracker
content:
I use this mostly to get the photo book at the end, but it is also very useful for family to keep track of your whereabouts, live. 
I upload all photos with a synopsis of the day and then choose which photos to keep when ordering the book.
author: Swoosi

title: Keeping up with the relatives holiday
content: It’s fantastic to see the journey. All the places they say all the different types of food they eat while they’re doing their journey. It’s not being there but it’s a little bit closer. Than hearing their stories when I get back highly recommend.
author: No one would have this one

title: Brilliant travel app
content:
We’ve used this app for many years and so do our friends. Easy to use and a great forum for friends to follow your trip. 
Love the maps tracing your steps. 
When we get home the book is ready to print in a beautiful coffee table hard back book. Excellent quality.
author: Ally’s travels

title: Auto import of trips
content:
Absolutely loving this app. All round super cool.

The only issue I have been having is that you are only able to automatically create trips from photos when you first sign up

It’d be amazing if you could select a bunch of photos and create a trip from them.
author: haidar777

title: Travellers friend extraordinaire
content:
An amazingly useful and simple to use free application that these days every traveller would do well to download.
It usually works effectively even in the most remote places but does require some attention to detail if it’s full capabilities are to be utilised. 
I only wish I’d found Polarsteps years ago.
author: Black Diamond Images

title: My Travel Must Have App
content:
I love having Polarsteps to be able to record where we’ve been, what we’ve seen and who we met.

We’ve been travelling for just over two years now and I’ve recorded every step. I’ve printed two photos and the process was so simple and the quality fantastic.

We travelled 12 years ago and I still haven’t created photo books from that trip - Polarsteps just makes it so, so simple.

I even use it as a diary and often refer back to it to see where we were on a certain date or to remind myself of the names of the people we met.

I recommend Polarsteps 100%.
author: Lethal1408

title: Our trip diary and photo album
content: We’re hooked on Polarsteps 💥It’s awesome 🤩👏and allows our family and friends to check in with our adventures whenever they choose, while keeping our photos and happenings stored for us to look back on. The GPS tracking is brilliant.👍Brilliant app to use⭐️👍
author: You’re never too old 😎

title: Great app
content: Love this app. I love the way it allows me to document my travels along the way, and includes important location information I can access later. Also, I love the generate a book function. We now have three ‘trip’ books and will make one for every trip from here on.
author: notanotherhat

title: Lets the family know where I am.
content: Great app which shows my family where I am. It’s easy to use and I love being able to add photos. If I had one wish, I would love to be able to do a screenshot, including the town names, showing where I have been. But I am generally very happy with Polarsteps.
author: Moomsies

title: Great app to share travel with friends and family
content:
The app is great, simple to use and very convenient to share travel stories with friends and family. 
It would be even better if we could add our actual itinerary without the location tracking on, as it is available in the “plan” side of the app.
author: AuréR

title: Share with friends
content: This app is great for showing friends & family exactly where you are and post photos & info about your trip. The book you can buy at the end is really good quality and you can edit it the way that you want to.
author: Dish143

title: Robyn & John
content: Polar steps, has been the best way of staying in touch with family and friends as we all travel. We have three traveler's in South America (different areas) one in Vietnam & us in Tasmania. It means we know what each other is up to and can keep a record of what we are doing/have done with potos & captions. Love it!
author: Just living life !

title: Great travelling app
content: Great app for recording your travels, location, distances, photos and notes. Allows you to then print them in a lovely book should you so choose. Also great that family and friends can follow your journey. Have used it for many years and still love it.
author: Fpetal

title: Travel blog
content: I always use Polarsteps to record and share my travels. I’m on an 8 month trip across Europe and it’s has been fantastic. I’m hoping to use the photo book option. One important improvement they must do is to allow text on photos. It’s confusing and difficult at the moment to link text to an image.
author: Minibus Nana

title: Close to Perfect; Needs Photo Captions & Comments
content: Great app that I would give 5 stars if just one feature was added, being able to put an explanatory note (limit it to 250 chars) on each photo. I’d give a 6th star if you were able to put comments per photo, as well as the Step. (Facebook can do it ; surely you can too?)
author: Mark of Bitcoin

title: Great app
content: This is exactly what I have been looking for, the one thing that I would love to see is that you can import photos from Facebook or albums from Facebook from travels that have already occurred. Also would be good if you could edit the place names as most of the ones I have set up have the wrong name for locations.
author: Scout_Hudson

title: Capturing our lap
content: What a great app for us to be able to record our lap. You  take pics and comments for each place and it tracks your travels as you go. Also your friends or family can follow you so they know where you are. Highly recommended
author: Gwelps

title: Fantastic app!
content: Have used this app for a few years now and have introduced to many friends. Absolutely love it! Just received my album from last holiday - wow, the quality is amazing. Makes it so easy when you get home as all the writing and photos are there!
author: katarina39

title: Keeping in touch
content: Been great for helping us keep in touch with our family who are travelling in northern Australia. Their photos & posts allow us to feel like we are a part of their journey. The map is great as it shows us at a glance where they have travelled. Overall a great app.
author: carries careful

title: Travel Diary
content: I am an early adopter of this great app and have introduced it to many friends in Australia. It’s easy to use and share, and it’s the only method I need to record all my travels. I just wish I could get out of the country so I can show more than one country in my stats!
author: WasWorkin’

title: A travel must!
content: I absolutely love this app. It helps keep track of my adventures and photos and makes a fabulous photo memory at the end of the trip. Bring able to share our journey with family and friends is fabulous! Highly recommended!
author: attobrig

title: First time user
content: We are using the app to document our caravan travels. Each step has enabled us to understand more how to use. We have found the app a very easy  way of showing our progress our friends and family
author: New Valentine Wanderer

title: Steve
content: Used Polarsteps on a 2000 km 67 day trip down the Murray River (Australia) in a 4mtr “Tinny”. It was fantastic to track our trip and keep a record of all our stops and sights. The tracking on the map was the only fault we found with lots of “Phantom” steps. This was not as relevant to us as the notes and pictures were however.  I am hoping this has been rectified on our trip to New Zealand this time. 👍
author: Ariel SA1

title: Easy holiday journaling
content: I used this app on a trip around Aus. It mapped our route, picked up photos from our travels and at the end I bought the book- split the journey into two separate books. It was very easy and the quality is amazing. Very much recommend.
author: Dj—ay

title: Memory Keeper 🫶🏼
content: For me finding this app is a great way to show my trips on a global visual. It’s so fun to see where I’ve been. When I get it up to date I will share with friends and family so they can keep up with what I’m up to instead of on social media platforms.
author: j_sandz

title: The best
content:
Used Polarsteps for the first time recently on our trip “half way round Oz “
Found it very easy to use and easy to order a printed copy . 
The book now has priority on our coffee table viewed by many.
Also love the ability that the app follows and tracks your movements.
author: dhutime

title: Would not recommend for road trips
content: I used this app for a few road trips it keeps adding in flights that I didn’t have and can’t get rid of them. It’s a total waste of time to upload your photos only to have the distance displayed as completely incorrect. I tried to email support but they didn’t reply. Had it worked I would have purchased the photo books but now I need to create new books in another program because of this problem
author: amac

title: Great app
content: Love the app and how we’ve been able to track the first month of our five month trip around Australia so far. However, I’m frustrated when the app suddenly closes while I’m in the middle of adding a step and either my text, photos, or both, disappear and I have to redo them. I’ve looked in care there’s an app update but I have the latest version.
author: Mirab75

title: Very good
content: I love this app. My only gripe is that I went on a cruise and those times where I have no network and then get it again, the app automatically puts me flying a different route. I can’t adjust the route to where we actually sailed. I can change the method of travel to ship but it reverts back automatically
author: Rmbgal1

title: Aussie trip
content:
So far, Polarsteps has been our only chosen means of advertising our adventure. So easy to use, abs friend followers have been thrilled. 
Our main big plus for using Polarsteps, is that the Grandkids can see exactly where we are, and have been. Wonderful visual for them ❤️💥
author: GinKarlMurphy

title: A Great App
content: I am so glad I found Polarsteps as it was so easy to use. I only had to use it once a day so that my family and friends could see exactly where we were. It saved the hassle of emailing everyone and it is now a fantastic record of our holiday. I am now going to purchase a Travel Book. 😀😀
author: Sue987654

title: Great record of our travels.
content: Love being able to select our best photos and write a bit about our travels on the go. Just sometimes you lose what you are writing whilst writing and you have to start over. Can be frustrating when it happens multiple times with the one entry.
author: Mob and Mossy

title: Great Memories Recorded
content: Fantastic app for remembering the what, when, where and how of your trips. Sometimes it is a bit flaky when there is no data service and will straight line between stops. I also found it hard to correct mistakes and distances recorded by the app are not always accurate. A great app overall
author: hz95vs

title: Awesome!!
content: Have been using this app non stop for 4 years! The tracking works on flight mode as well which makes it easy to plot pics when you’re back in reception. The planning feature is great & good to share with followers
author: Daisyhutch

title: Easy to use and looks great
content: My favourite way to document our travels. The closed network means we can share amongst those we know since we post photos of our kids. Really glad that we can now share authorship. So easy to use and looks great.
author: Trishtrang

title: Your holiday album
content: Such a great app to take with you on your travels. When you’re planning your travels, download the app, put in the wheres and when’s and then when you are there just add your photos and drop a note in. The holiday album is complete!
author: Cunnyfunk

title: Love the app- can you upload from GoPro photos?
content:
Love this app so much, thank you team. 

Almost finished our trip and I can’t wait for ordering a book.  Our best photos are from our go pro on our iPad but If I can’t seem to upload them. I can only see photos from my Google photos. Any help would be amazing

title: The best travel app
content: We love tracking our travel on this app so our family and friends can see where we are/have been and where all of our photos were taken! Amazing app, can’t recommend it enough!
author: Ekhmick

title: Fun watching family and friends on their travel
content: It was fun watching friends and family on their holiday as well as reading their travel diary. So much happens on trips, by the time we get home we forget half of it, great way to save the memories
author: HappySpec67C

title: Game changer for following adventures
content: Polarsteps has been an absolute game changer for travelling. It allows our friends and family to follow our adventures without needing social media accounts. It also allows us to follow our friends on their adventures as well. We love it!
author: TheGemWitch13

title: The best travel app ever!!!
content: Our family and friends love seeing our travels as they happen. It’s also fantastic that you can narrate as well as add photos. This is great when you come home and look back on it as you forget some details.
author: Princess31 12 2000

title: Just brilliant
content: I’ve found this app just brilliant. It keeps my family and friends up to date on where I am (exactly) and what I’m doing. I’m using it like a diary. My followers are also finding it great to keep in contact and to see where I am.
author: Ozdessey

title: Way too slow for loading images and videos
content:
I just can’t understand how it can be that slow, please prefetch images, compress or improve that, it feels like 2010. 
It ruins the whole user experience.
There are easy quick wins : if you re in a carousel just fetch the next image in advance in the background.
I am surprised I am the only one complaining here, everyone I know using the app is having the same issue
Otherwise great app for traveling and sharing
author: Robinlietar

title: Amazing.
content: I absolutely love this app. It does a great job of tracking trips, showing them off and inspiring yourself and others. Developers respond quickly to suggestions or requests, and the app is overall excellent. It’s definitely my favourite travel app!
author: Slow Internet user

title: Absolute rubbish
content:
Tried years ago to follow my mother on a trip. Uninstalled because it didn’t work. 

They just went on another trip so I tried again… same thing happened again.

Can’t open their link to follow her. Can’t add my location because it doesn’t exist. Ok so I go to add a closer, bigger city, which I found and ‘something went wrong’. How does anyone use this app????

Tried to update my profile and can’t add an image, can’t add my name or email. My profile name is too short.

Absolutely rubbish app. My phone and app is up to date.
author: bivoir
